summary: Two things happened this week and they point in opposite directions. GOOD: the customs/lives tracker finally landed. Shayna set up Notion herself on 8/28, chased the invite on 8/30, Mayson escalated it inside a minute, Fred acknowledged in the same minute and delivered the invite on 8/31 with edit access — closing a request first made on 2026-07-20, 42 days old and the single highest-leverage open item on the account. BAD: the moment she got visibility she found a private live sold for $4,700, and on 9/3 Fred admitted the reason — 'I still have internal notes with the team that you do 1:1 on OnlyFans'. She banned private lives on 2026-07-27 and re-reminded on 2026-08-03; 37 days later the instruction had still never reached the chat team's written notes, and a fan has paid $4,700 for something she does not intend to do. She also found the new board pre-populated with items already completed ('Also some of these have been done for a while'), and had to ask what a fan paid for used panties (Fred: 'Dante paid $600.'). Her follow-up question on 9/3 — 'Okay, why did that guy pay so much for a private live do you know?' — was still unanswered at week close. Stephski issued the Aug 15-31 invoice on 9/1 (7-day terms, due ~9/8) but still has never confirmed receipt of the Aug 1-14 payment she completed on 8/26 — now 9 days and a new invoice went out on top of it. Michelle delivered her 9th consecutive on-time leak report (9/1) and was thanked. Mica has now sent nothing for 22 days.

health.rationale: Up 2 from 40 (58 → 46 → 42 → 40 → 42), the first rise after four straight declines, and it is a fragile one. The rise is earned by real delivery: the 42-day customs tracker was invited and populated (8/31), Fred's response latency collapsed from weeks to under a minute on 8/30 and ~33 hours to delivery, Mayson escalated twice and got movement, Michelle hit her 9th consecutive on-time leak report, and the Aug 15-31 invoice went out on schedule on 9/1. It is capped there because the week also produced the clearest proof yet of the underlying failure: Fred's own 9/3 message confirms a standing client instruction from 7/27, re-reminded 8/3, never reached the chat team's internal notes — and the cost is a $4,700 private live sold to a fan she will not perform for. That sits alongside the still-untouched VIP full-nude make-whole (24 days, never mentioned since 8/11) as a second unresolved fan-money exposure. Stephski still has not acknowledged the 8/26 payment 9 days on, and issued a new invoice without doing so, which is the exact mechanism that made two of the last four cycles late. Tone from the client remains warm and non-escalatory ('Thank you :)', 9/1) and she has not gone to Derrek since 4/26, but she is home, back on EST and now has a tracker — her detection rate is about to go up sharply.
